decks.notes: This UR Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays using cheap, efficient creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly to the opponent. The deck includes cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear to apply pressure early on, as well as cards like Lava Dart and Lightning Bolt to finish off the opponent. By combining creatures with direct damage spells, the deck aims to win the game before the opponent can set up their defenses. The key concept is to apply relentless pressure and quickly close out the game.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature strategies combined with the ability to repeatedly blink your own creatures for added value. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, you can protect your creatures from removal while also triggering powerful enter-the-battlefield effects multiple times. This deck excels at disrupting your opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also presenting a quick clock with Overlord of the Balemurk and Solitude. The mana base is designed to support both the aggressive game plan and the blink synergies.

The deck focuses on using Basking Broodscale to generate mana through its ability and then casting big creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End. The deck also includes cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Blade of the Bloodchief to support the Combo strategy. The deck includes disruptive elements like Thought-Knot Seer to disrupt opponent's strategy. With the combination of ramp, disruption, and powerful threats, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game quickly.

This Modern 1 vs 1 deck revolves around assembling combo pieces to create a powerful engine that can generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining artifacts like Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble with creatures like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Oswald Fiddlebender, the deck can generate mana and card advantage while controlling the board with cards like Pithing Needle and Portable Hole. The deck aims to win through card advantage and synergy between its components, making it a versatile and challenging deck to pilot effectively.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy and resources using cards like Solitude, Relic of Progenitus, and Cleansing Wildfire. It aims to maintain board control with removal spells like Path to Exile and Wrath of the Skies while also generating card advantage with Price of Freedom and The Legend of Roku. The deck also has a land destruction element with cards like Demolition Field and Field of Ruin, aiming to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Kaheera, the Orphanguard serves as a companion to provide additional synergy with the deck's creatures.

The deck focuses on using creatures with powerful abilities to generate value and disrupt opponents, while also utilizing powerful combo pieces like Emrakul, the Promised End and Glaring Fleshraker to win the game in explosive fashion. The deck also includes various support cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Malevolent Rumble to enhance its creatures and control the board. The deck's unique mix of creature synergy and combo potential allows for versatile gameplay and the ability to adapt to different matchups effectively.

The deck focuses on creating a fast and aggressive board presence by quickly deploying artifact creatures and utilizing cards like Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble for mana acceleration. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats like Kappa Cannoneer and Salvage Titan while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Engineered Explosives and Tormod's Crypt. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Pithing Needle allows for versatility and adaptability against a variety of strategies, while Blood Moon can provide a strong lockout effect against multicolor decks.

This Aggro-Affinity deck relies on quickly and efficiently deploying artifacts to build a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble, along with powerful artifacts like Engineered Explosives and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to control the game tempo and apply pressure through various threats like Kappa Cannoneer and Pinnacle Emissary. Emry, Lurker of the Loch helps recur artifacts from the graveyard, while Metallic Rebuke provides valuable disruption. The deck's key strategy is to utilize its artifact synergies to generate advantage and close out games quickly.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures like Basking Broodscale and Emrakul, the Promised End to create a dominating board presence. It also includes various support cards such as Sowing Mycospawn and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and powerful spells. The inclusion of cards like Kozilek's Command and Ancient Stirrings helps to ensure consistency in drawing the necessary pieces for the combo.

This deck focuses on creating a powerful combo using the synergy between Basking Broodscale, Blade of the Bloodchief, and Malevolent Rumble to generate a massive amount of mana and pump up creatures for a game-ending attack. The deck uses cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and Sowing Mycospawn for additional threats and control elements, while also including disruption and tutoring cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Ancient Stirrings to ensure the combo can be assembled effectively. The deck is designed to quickly ramp up and overwhelm opponents with its explosive potential.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. It uses cards like Disciple of Freyalise and Green Sun's Zenith to accelerate mana production, while controlling the board with cards like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble. The deck also includes support cards like Ugin, Eye of the Storms to provide additional control and removal options. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive Eldrazi creatures and disrupt their game plan with a combination of ramp and control elements.

This deck focuses on utilizing various instant reanimation spells to bring powerful creatures back from the graveyard, such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Griselbrand. It also includes cards like Ephemerate and Solitude to protect key pieces and disrupt opponents' strategies. By combining instant reanimation with disruptive spells and powerful creatures, the deck aims to create explosive turns that can quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory. Additionally, the inclusion of a diverse land base and versatile spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation offer flexibility and adaptability to various matchups.

This deck aims to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures using cycling cards and cascade spells until the player can cast Living End to bring all creatures back onto the battlefield, while also controlling the opponent's board with cards like Force of Negation and Endurance. The deck includes creatures with cycling abilities to effectively dig through the library and find necessary pieces for the combo. Additionally, cards like Street Wraith and Violent Outburst help in cycling through the deck quickly to set up the combo as soon as possible.

The deck focuses on using cards like Unearth and Persist to bring back powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones from the graveyard. By combining this reanimation strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push for disruption, as well as card draw and selection with Faithless Looting and Thought Scour, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with dangerous threats. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while also providing flexibility for its spells.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear, supported by cheap spells like Mishra's Bauble and Lava Dart to pump up their power. The deck also includes cards like Mutagenic Growth and Monstrous Rage to further boost the damage output. Preordain and Expressive Iteration help to dig for more threats and keep the pressure on. Overall, the deck aims to consistently apply pressure and close out games quickly with a mix of efficient creatures and burn spells.
